name: cloud-armor-two-halves
description: Cloud Armor needs two halves that nothing validates: a GCP-project policy (deploy/gcp/cloud-armor.sh) and a BackendConfig + cloud.google.com/backend-config Service annotation; a rename or missing annotation ships an unprotected ingress with zero errors, so pin the names in a test (scripts/cloud-armor.test.ts).

title: BackendConfig timeoutSec must exceed the longest watched run
rationale: GCE backend services default to a 30s response timeout, which severs warren's unbounded NDJSON event streams; the warren BackendConfig carries timeoutSec 3600.

title: WAF injection rule sets stay --preview on warren
rationale: Request bodies are agent prompts containing shell, SQL and HTML by design; only framing/caller signatures (protocolattack, scannerdetection) are safe to enforce.
